information_flow: The first call receives every common input and emits one complete executable policy capsule. The second consumes that capsule, reopens only anchor_policy and anchor_contract, and emits one complete executable policy state. The final call consumes that state, simultaneously reopens task_constraints, loop_structure, task, and candidate_hypothesis, reconciles their joint implications in the inherited artifact, and emits one policy.
name: Terminally Contracted Reentry Relay
organization: three-call sequential lineage preserving one complete executable artifact while contracting the two terminal evidence windows into one co-visible transition

calls.objective: Reconcile the initially visible evidence and obligations into one complete executable policy artifact.

Consume originate_executable_capsule, expose the inherited artifact to the reentered anchor evidence and contract obligations, reconcile visible conflicts directly in that artifact, and emit one complete executable policy state.

Consume anchor_window_transition, expose the inherited complete artifact simultaneously to the reentered constraints, structural evidence, task, and hypothesis, reconcile their joint obligations in that artifact, and emit one complete policy.
